name: Chocolate Apples
subtitle: Fruit dipped in smooth chocolate with crisp toppings
description: Coat prepared apples in melted chocolate, decorate them, and let the coating set for an easy handheld treat.

ingredients.item: of each white and dark chocolate chopped (optional)
skewers wooden chopsticks or large lolly sticks

instructions.text: Wash and dry the apples thoroughly. If they have a waxy coating, briefly dip them in boiling water, then drain and dry completely.
Insert a skewer, chopstick, or lolly stick into the stem end of each apple.
Melt the milk chocolate, and the optional white and dark chocolate, separately or together in heatproof bowls over gently simmering water. Stir until smooth.
Hold each apple by its stick and dip it into the melted chocolate, turning to coat. Let excess chocolate drip back into the bowl.
Add the sprinkles, chopped nuts, or honeycomb pieces while the coating is still soft. Transfer the apples to a lined tray and leave until set.
